newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Xios fixed income tops funds with 11.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Xios fixed income tops funds with 11.64 pct.

text.p: Greek Xios fixed income fund was first among all funds of its class for the eighth consecutive month, with a year-to-date return of 11.64 percent or an annualised return of 17.50 percent, Xios Bank said.

The fund's assets grew at impressive rates and exceeded 10 billion drachmas on August 30, it said in a statement. Its asset allocation is 84 percent in five-and -seven year bonds, 14 percent in time deposits and two percent in stocks.
Its Xios-Alma deposit account offers annual rates of 12.40 percent for the period September 16 to September 22 and monthly interest payments.
The base rate for business credit was steady at 20.25 percent, the bank said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
